item: The tuning pass after a bulk import merges the search index in bounded, stoppable steps instead of one 'optimize'
refs: PR #2022; import-speed plan; field restore measurements 2026-11-15
summary: Field measurement: the queue's post-run FTS5 'optimize' held the writer gate for more than 32 minutes and the post-import re-index could not start until it let go. merge_fts_segments runs SQLite's incremental 'merge' (a POSITIVE count, 2000 pages a step), each step in its own short hold of the gate, until SQLite's own done signal (fewer than two rows changed), the queue's Stop, or OO_FTS_MERGE_BUDGET_S (default 300 s; 0 skips). It leaves a few segments per level, as automerge does, rather than one. A negative count (merge toward one segment) was the first cut and a review measured it fragmenting the index when articles were written between steps (4 to 122 segments in a test; FTS5's 2000-segment cap would then fail the collector's inserts); tests/test_fts_optimize.py pins that it cannot come back. What is left stays correct and the next bulk pass carries on. optimize_after_bulk's fts flag still means fully merged.
